title: [P1] Bunker port pool exhaustion prevented the battery from running
detail: run_battery FAIL: "spawn attempt 2 failed: bunker: spawn agent: internal: port range allocation: no free port ranges available (pool exhausted: 1 ranges)". Read-only probe `env HOME=/home/kara bunker status --server bunker-las-02` confirmed the server is ONLINE with Agents 1/8; the reported pool capacity is only one range, already occupied, so the battery remains unverified.
